slides.title: "For research only"
slides.text: "Not for human use" means exactly that: the product is not meant for people.

slides.title: A different form
slides.text: FDA warns: salt forms (sodium, acetate) are not the same active ingredient as in the approved drug. Counterfeit Ozempic has also been found.

slides.title: Dosing errors
slides.text: FDA has received adverse event reports linked to dosing errors with non-approved semaglutide. Some people were hospitalized.
